name: Sentora PRIME Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDPRIMEv2 is Sentora's PYUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle PYUSD.
collateral: PYUSD loans against the Hastra PRIME token (0x19ebb35279a16207ec4ba82799cc64715065f7f6; on-chain name Hastra PRIME), described by Sentora as Figure home-equity credit exposure. Enforceable collateral recovery priority remains unresolved.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for PYUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. liquidityAdapter() is zero at the pinned review; ordinary cash redemptions use idle assets unless assets are first deallocated. Shared market liquidity and an in-kind position exit do not promise full-size cash redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0xc21b08c16458202593d4d9b26b9984ee67b38bbd is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over PYUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. asset(), decimals(), totalSupply(), convertToAssets() and ordinary one-share redeem simulation were reverified at Ethereum block 26107702. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent. Exact deployment creation: Morpho vaultV2ByAddress creationBlockNumber=25052763, creationTimestamp=1778272391 (2026-05-08T20:33:11.000Z); independently retrieved 2026-10-03.
